channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The clearest win this period is $244.5 million in FEMA infrastructure funds released for water, power, housing and road projects (part of a $1.3 billion COR3 disbursement push), alongside a $490 million DOE loan closing for Pattern Energy battery storage and continued private capital moves — MVP Toyota's $11 million Caguas dealership, a $15 million Riviera Marketplace retail plaza, San Juan's first direct municipal bond issuance drawing Act 60 private-equity buyers, and preliminary South Korean (Hanil Electric) interest in siting operations here. Banesco USA posted strong Q2 growth ($1 billion in deposits, 59% net income growth), a positive banking-sector signal.
